entry: Diagnosed the bridge "outage" that wasn't — turned out 10.0.0.49 is Alienware's own Wi-Fi interface, and the missing /api/status route made Plato think the wrong service was running. Added the route, restarted clean. Small fix, big lesson: verify the topology before assuming a network problem. Also found Tailscale was logged out — root cause of all cross-machine failures today.
